name: E17 (user-proposed E16; E16 true-mass already exists)
scope: same144 headtiles994 sets, common legal panels; no new states/QKV/video/network/global solver
A: exact gain = I - B + D; I=-2E.dot(de)/Z^2/C, B=norm(de)^2/Z^2/C, D=norm(E+de)^2*(1/Z^2-1/Znew^2)/C; normalize all by DenseZ as cached; store candidate terms Q64 and matching Q16 sums; validate against original gains
B: full_v and mean_only; score Iproxy-lambda Bproxy, Iproxy=mean16(2H.v), Bproxy=mean16(norm(v)^2); original lambda1 and one train-fitted lambda per representation; no rank8 retraining
fit: single global nonnegative lambda, shared all layers/states; profile nonnegative least squares a*I-b*B to real Q64 gain, lambda=b/a; positive common a is nuisance and never used online. Per-event labels/stdG and features/common online RMS; equal event and equal state-action weights. Analytic 2-variable NNLS, no grid. If a=0,b>0 classify infinite lambda limit (no positive action); if both zero zero-information no-op
selection: development initial Risk36 only, choose lambda1 or train-fitted by mean true relative gain with fixed score>0 gate; tie favors baseline; freeze before evaluation; report both even if negative; no additional threshold
split: city101 train36, city303 development36, horse101/303 evaluation72
denominator_diagnostic: lambda1 unchanged direction/amplitude; true current Z weights with deltaZ=0 and full true Z,Znew panels. mean16(||H||^2/Z^2-||-H+v||^2/Znew^2). Offline teacher information, not deployable; no mixing raw FP32 outputs with FP64 goal
metrics: risk separately from post-risk and all; equal event then state weight; candidate sign accuracy excluding numerical ties, selected-action actual gain/regret/recovery/degradation, positive-label filtering diagnostic; distributions of exact I,B,D; no causality claim from decomposition
